# Continue recorded usage into customer billing

This complete native operation consumes the original Merchant Performance customer programme and carries its saved recipient case through customer receiving, an original invoice, a dated calendar and full source delivery.

## Source and existing input

The complete current Pricing/Commercial source is retained in canonical Git blob598a222c3ca2fa480359e33dca02955e9f22f00e in woahwhattheheck/tjlabs-stellar-merchant-workspace: 8,072,936 UTF-8 bytes, SHA256 31e20a31de004333d72d8fc3161ed7a0b82681b22f5b5c9703a9d9c819cb5723. It carries the complete411-file current source and the frozen181-file original tariff source separately, including the twelve original workspace browser assets needed by the integrated listener. Preserve both original source roots and the saved operation paths.

The original Commercial continuation is commercial/performance-native.mjs cc213fc484dca1ac5f57a090ac481ceb11778fc7, 23,030 bytes, with Pricing performance/interfaces-native.mjs 5188d933e9add96c79694e5b493fee320f013a65, 25,134 bytes. These PR349 successors retain the complete outer result, original receiving receipt and downloader endpoint through restart. They operate on the same native04 case and its retained requests.

Materialize the full financial dependency capsule delivered with this programme over the selected current source. Its original Accounting, Receivables, service calendar, payment request, refund and installment source paths are supplied as complete files. Each declared browser manifest travels with every served asset. The frozen tariff foundation remains the original completed input.

The current source root also needs the complete existing Service agreements / Receivables / Accounting product and the final four-file accepted-tariff importer/UI/documentation join delivered with this helper. Keep the original C12 financial adapter and its declared source dependencies when composing the same installed product. The helper dynamically imports only the maintained original modules listed in its source; it introduces no pricing model or settlement engine.

The native-run directory must contain the original completed tariff operation: operation.json, flow-result.json, pricing/, received-pricing/, retained requests, backup and exports. Existing requests and workspace IDs remain in those files. The original completed ASTRA-DU archive is1,554,766 bytes, SHA256 c6f37f7f926e84cf1d139e82e5acb10cb65dbab0cd226ae9b18fe6c534504fb4,317 members. Its original operation path is /mnt/data/tariff-native/SCF-MERCHANT-TARIFFS-25FD-20261012/native. The source owner also retained a later original foundation result in Slack Canvas F0C8G6S7ZNZ. Select the actual existing producer/retained archive through the original Pricing receiving thread.

Restore the original operation and its source paths consistently with operation.json. The complete existing customer run may be supplied as customer-run. If performance-run/flow-result.json is already COMPLETE, this helper reads and continues that result. Otherwise it calls the unchanged current runPerformanceCommercial with the existing native-run and the selected customer-run. Reconcile its original receiving owner before starting that producer.

## Run in the same private process lifetime

Node22.16+ and Python3 are required. All application logic comes from the original source; Python's standard tarfile library writes the final private archive.

    node /ABS/source/experiments/merchant-performance-financial-84df-20261012/performance-financial.mjs \
      --source-root /ABS/source \
      --native-run /ABS/native \
      --performance-run /ABS/performance \
      --output /ABS/financial \
      --python python3

Optional original customer directory:

    --customer-run /ABS/existing-customer-operation

The financial output must be a separate private sibling of native-run and performance-run. The helper copies their complete finished states into its own output after closing accounting. Supply an explicit --start-date YYYY-MM-DD when required; otherwise the first day of the next current UTC month is selected and retained in operation.json. Default term is three whole months, billing one whole month at a time, currency scale2. Explicit options are --term-months, --billing-months and --currency-scale.

The exported function is runPerformanceFinancial({sourceRoot,nativeRun,performanceRun,customerRun,output,python,startDate,termMonths,billingMonths,currencyScale,actor}). It returns the complete result and private archive descriptor. Repeating the same original inputs reopens its retained request files. Each new retained operation or request is fully written and synced to a private temporary file before the destination is atomically created; an interrupted write cannot select a partial request as the completed input.

## Complete customer workflow

The helper reads the original performance result's measured, old-rate and revised-native-rate quote IDs/SHAs from its recipient CaseStore. It keeps all three ordinary QUOTE_JSON payload downloads and readable documents, plus the complete original QUOTE material envelopes.

A preexisting accepted response to the chosen revised quote is reused. Otherwise the original Commercial receive command records the native fixture's response with its explicit source reference. Commercial's original download kinds are QUOTE, QUOTE_JSON and HANDOFF; RESPONSE_JSON is not a download kind. The helper receives the exact original response and quote envelopes through commissioningFileBytes using their retained material SHA256.

The complete native performance SOURCE, ATTACHMENT and readable REPORT are retained. The original Commercial CLI exports the complete accepted case at its actual revision. That same complete recipient CaseStore remains in the retained Performance operation.

The actual original saved proposal report is downloaded from Pricing as report/report.json and retained unchanged. For compatible native payment options, the maintained preparePricingReportImport adapter supplies the accounting terms directly.

The existing repository Pricing fixture deliberately contains UNVERIFIED_DEMO_ASSET and UNVERIFIED_DEMO_RECIPIENT. Its completed quote and performance source preserve those exact original values. The financial continuation identifies this precise original fixture through all three original fixture Git identities and the saved report's route and payment fields. It initializes the original empty Accounting workspace with the exact463-byte terms emitted by the existing receivables/EXERCISE.mjs (Git033ae261caf720f1de950fb3273b35a8dd05598e; terms SHA256 bc186f2afeb60acca3989b214acaa1d6d2d2d73c7c8b21fe0872ed0ae1afe298). The original outbox and proof directories remain empty. pricing-source/source.json records that fixture role, its complete producer identity, the actual original report hash and the original import outcome.

The selected Commercial quote remains the invoice's price authority. Its complete original payment and performance bindings travel through the source files; the original customer writer creates the linked accounting profile.

Both original quotations go through compileQuoteInvoice for a one-month price comparison. The original programme's earlier1500-request quotation yields17.10 USD for its route at0.0114 per request; the chosen native revision yields16.50 USD at0.011. These values are checked against the actual returned original route values. The observed source period, usage quantity and costs remain separate from that explicit proposed monthly volume.

ServiceAgreementWorkspace creates the selected calendar from the chosen exact quote and response. Its original bill method imports the first due period into the existing Receivables owner; the original invoice review and issue methods produce the issued customer document. Every invoice source, review and period retains the complete original tariff/performance binding.

The helper closes and reopens the same Accounting workspace through its original HTTP listener, uses the typed Agreement client and downloads a complete agreement TAR. It checks every immutable invoice, quotation and calendar file against the first retained export. Each capture's original files.json is verified against all of that capture's own bytes.

The original status.json writer records an actual observation time and computes invoice status at its own UTC date. The later HTTP status is validated through the original invoiceSummary function at that recorded date, retaining its complete current fields. Both full captures remain available as agreement.tar and agreement-http.tar. The served invoice/agreement browser assets are checked against their complete selected source.

## Finished delivery

The private financial output includes:

- index.html with the observed source,17.10/16.50 comparison, selected response, invoice and calendar links.
- commercial/ with exact measured/earlier/revised quote envelopes and payloads, chosen response, complete performance source/report, full current case record and workspace.
- accepted-case-package/ from the original Commercial exporter.
- pricing-source/ with the actual saved pricing report, original accounting input and its complete source-role description.
- accounting/, outbox/ and proofs/ containing the closed original financial operation.
- invoice/ with the complete issued JSON/HTML/CSV, original manifest/status and retained quote/response/source/review.
- agreement/ and agreement.tar with the first complete calendar JSON/HTML/CSV and source documents; agreement-http.tar preserves the separate original HTTP capture.
- customer-account/ and customer-account.tar from the existing account exporter.
- originals/tariff-operation/ and originals/performance-operation/ with complete saved source-operation state; the operated recipient CaseStore is originals/performance-operation/recipient-cases/.
- requests/, captures/, operation.json, flow-result.json and files.json retaining the complete operation inputs, original full file sets and returned identities.

The finished archive is OUTPUT.tar.gz, with its original path, byte length and SHA256 in OUTPUT.archive.json and the returned result. It is created privately with no external upload. Interrupted archive generation retains its previous artifact and completes a new temporary archive before selecting it.

Operation inputs, original requests and captured outputs are retained through the existing atomic CaseStore artifact writer. Each complete export file set is saved before its member files are materialized, so a restart preserves one coherent original manifest. Existing quote, response, agreement, invoice, preview and request IDs are reused by their original models. The first invoice status and both completed export captures remain the retained originals.

For an actual failure, the helper retains its phase, original exception and request files under failures/. Continue that same operation with the source correction; the original response, agreement, invoice and source ownership stay with their retained IDs. The COMPLETE result is checked against its original operation, case, selected quote and native/performance result hashes before it is returned on replay.

## Following financial source on the same saved customer case

The complete original native04 source is retained in `source-transfer.json` and its seven `source-parts/` files. Each ordered part contains raw UTF-8 text in `content`. The index records every complete part and whole-source byte length, SHA-256 and Git blob.

The complete `financial-source-successor.json` carries nine current original financial dependencies, this guide and the source receiver. The dependencies retain the accepted Service renewal checks and original Service validators, together with the maintained calendar-month payment-plan implementation. The source receiver verifies all 471 original current files and 181 frozen files, checks every successor's captured preimage, then publishes the complete following tree. Its two added original renewal modules and receiving utility produce 474 source files.

The original Performance operation remains bound to `/dev/scf-performance-25fd-20261012-native04/work/source`, with its existing `work/original-native` and `work/performance` directories. Finish that original operation before running the following financial step: `work/performance/flow-result.json` must have its original schema and `state: "COMPLETE"`. This preserves the actual recipient case, quote history, source documents and request IDs. The original helper can call the Performance producer when that result is missing, so this continuation requires the completed result first.

The following financial operation is bound to the separate `/dev/scf-performance-25fd-20261012-native04/work/financial-source` tree. If `work/performance-financial/operation.json` already exists, preserve its exact recorded `sourceRoot` and existing request identities. The receiving utility checks that binding before writing; an existing operation bound to another tree continues from its own recorded tree.

From a checkout containing this complete maintained experiment directory, materialize the following source with the literal command:

```sh
python3 experiments/merchant-performance-financial-84df-20261012/receive-financial-source.py \
  --index experiments/merchant-performance-financial-84df-20261012/source-transfer.json \
  --successor experiments/merchant-performance-financial-84df-20261012/financial-source-successor.json \
  --output /dev/scf-performance-25fd-20261012-native04/work/financial-source
```

It reads the saved COMPLETE Performance result and existing financial operation binding, validates the full source before writing, and materializes only the separate source directory. An interrupted source receive resumes from exact existing preimages or postimages; source files are published atomically. `SOURCE_READY` reports the full source count and actual successor digest.

Then invoke the existing original financial programme from that source tree:

```sh
node /dev/scf-performance-25fd-20261012-native04/work/financial-source/experiments/merchant-performance-financial-84df-20261012/performance-financial.mjs \
  --source-root /dev/scf-performance-25fd-20261012-native04/work/financial-source \
  --native-run /dev/scf-performance-25fd-20261012-native04/work/original-native \
  --performance-run /dev/scf-performance-25fd-20261012-native04/work/performance \
  --output /dev/scf-performance-25fd-20261012-native04/work/performance-financial \
  --python python3
```

The existing financial programme continues the original recipient case, accepted response, revised quotation, pricing/performance source and native IDs. Its operation and complete output retain the exact source descriptors it actually loads. The original native04 Performance source and frozen foundation remain attached to their own completed records. The existing 84DF receiver owns this same customer operation and reconciles the latest saved native04 archive before continuing it.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Materialize the complete following financial source for the retained native04 case."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import tempfile

INDEX_GIT = "0c5ca60440d46895bcd2c03a6254850708f29620"
BASE_GIT = "0fff38e8e50d8c96be1b3f91cad7b4f8e8dc2c01"
BASE_SHA = "6a0bb5c96335fcc82cee328b4932952b84437c6e42eda53e69c3b539c8b816e5"
BASE_BYTES = 9291618


def git_blob(data):
    return hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(data)).encode("ascii") + b"\0" + data).hexdigest()


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def checked(data, descriptor, label):
    require(len(data) == descriptor["bytes"], label + ": byte length changed")
    require(hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == descriptor["sha256"], label + ": SHA-256 changed")
    require(git_blob(data) == descriptor["gitBlob"], label + ": Git blob changed")
    return data


def relative(value):
    require(isinstance(value, str) and value and "\\" not in value and "\0" not in value,
            "Invalid source path")
    require(not value.startswith("/") and all(p not in ("", ".", "..") for p in value.split("/")),
            "Source paths must be relative and exact")
    return Path(*value.split("/"))


def absolute(value):
    require(isinstance(value, str) and os.path.isabs(value), "Use an absolute source/output path")
    return Path(os.path.abspath(value))


def no_symlinks(path):
    for item in (*reversed(path.parents), path):
        if item.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError("Source destination contains a symbolic link: " + str(item))


def disjoint(left, right):
    return left != right and left not in right.parents and right not in left.parents


def read_record(path):
    if not path.exists():
        return None
    require(path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink(), "Expected an original regular JSON record: " + str(path))
    return json.loads(path.read_bytes())


def source_map(rows, label):
    result = {}
    for row in rows:
        relative(row["path"])
        require(row["path"] not in result, label + ": duplicate source path")
        data = checked(row["content"].encode("utf-8"), row, row["path"])
        result[row["path"]] = (row, data)
    return result


def sync_directory(path):
    descriptor = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        os.fsync(descriptor)
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)


ensured_directories = set()


def durable_directory(path):
    no_symlinks(path)
    if path in ensured_directories:
        return
    if path.parent != path:
        durable_directory(path.parent)
    try:
        path.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    except FileExistsError:
        require(path.is_dir(), "Expected a source directory: " + str(path))
    sync_directory(path)
    if path.parent != path:
        sync_directory(path.parent)
    ensured_directories.add(path)


def atomic_source(path, data, prior):
    no_symlinks(path)
    durable_directory(path.parent)
    if path.exists():
        require(path.is_file(), "Expected a regular source file: " + str(path))
        existing = path.read_bytes()
        if existing == data:
            descriptor = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
            try:
                os.fsync(descriptor)
            finally:
                os.close(descriptor)
            sync_directory(path.parent)
            return False
        require(prior is not None and existing == prior,
                "Existing source differs from both its retained preimage and successor: " + str(path))
    else:
        existing = None
    descriptor, name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".receive-", suffix=".tmp", dir=path.parent)
    temporary = Path(name)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "wb") as stream:
            stream.write(data)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        if existing is None:
            try:
                os.link(temporary, path)
            except FileExistsError:
                require(path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink() and path.read_bytes() == data,
                        "Concurrent source differs: " + str(path))
        else:
            no_symlinks(path)
            require(path.is_file() and path.read_bytes() == existing,
                    "Source changed during receiving: " + str(path))
            os.replace(temporary, path)
        sync_directory(path.parent)
        require(path.read_bytes() == data, "Written source changed: " + str(path))
        return True
    finally:
        try:
            temporary.unlink()
        except FileNotFoundError:
            pass


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--index", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--successor", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    os.umask(0o077)
    index_bytes = args.index.read_bytes()
    require(git_blob(index_bytes) == INDEX_GIT, "Use the complete original PR386 source-transfer.json")
    index = json.loads(index_bytes)
    require(index["schema"] == "commons.complete-source-parts.v1", "Unknown source index")
    pieces = []
    ordered = sorted(index["parts"], key=lambda row: row["part"])
    require([row["part"] for row in ordered] == list(range(1, len(ordered) + 1)),
            "Source part sequence is incomplete")
    for descriptor in ordered:
        raw = checked((args.index.parent / relative(descriptor["path"])).read_bytes(),
                      descriptor, descriptor["path"])
        part = json.loads(raw)
        require(part["schema"] == "commons.complete-source-text-part.v1"
                and part["encoding"] == "utf-8"
                and part["part"] == descriptor["part"]
                and part["total"] == len(ordered) == descriptor["total"]
                and part["completeSourceGitBlob"] == BASE_GIT, "Source part identity differs")
        piece = part["content"].encode("utf-8")
        require(len(piece) == part["contentBytes"] == descriptor["sourceContentBytes"],
                "Source part content length differs")
        require(hashlib.sha256(piece).hexdigest() == part["contentSha256"] == descriptor["sourceContentSha256"],
                "Source part content digest differs")
        pieces.append(piece)
    capsule_bytes = checked(b"".join(pieces), index["completeSource"], "Complete original source")
    require(git_blob(capsule_bytes) == BASE_GIT and len(capsule_bytes) == BASE_BYTES
            and hashlib.sha256(capsule_bytes).hexdigest() == BASE_SHA, "Unexpected original source cohort")
    capsule = json.loads(capsule_bytes)
    base = source_map(capsule["files"], "Original current source")
    foundation = source_map(capsule["foundationFiles"], "Original frozen source")
    require(len(base) == capsule["fileCount"] == index["completeSource"]["fileCount"]
            and sum(len(data) for _, data in base.values()) == capsule["sourceBytes"]
            == index["completeSource"]["sourceBytes"], "Original current source counts differ")
    require(len(foundation) == index["completeSource"]["foundationFiles"]
            and sum(len(data) for _, data in foundation.values()) == index["completeSource"]["foundationSourceBytes"],
            "Original frozen source counts differ")

    successor_bytes = args.successor.read_bytes()
    successor = json.loads(successor_bytes)
    require(successor["schema"] == "stellar-forge.merchant-performance-financial-source-successor.v1",
            "Unknown financial source successor")
    require(successor["baseSourceTransferGitBlob"] == INDEX_GIT
            and successor["baseSourceGitBlob"] == BASE_GIT
            and successor["baseSourceBytes"] == BASE_BYTES
            and successor["baseSourceSha256"] == BASE_SHA, "Successor belongs to another original source")
    following = dict(base)
    for path, pair in source_map(successor["files"], "Following financial source").items():
        row, data = pair
        previous = base.get(path)
        require(row["expectedCapturedPreimage"] == (previous[0]["gitBlob"] if previous else None),
                "Captured source preimage differs: " + path)
        following[path] = pair
    require(len(following) == successor["graph"]["currentFileCount"]
            and sum(len(data) for _, data in following.values()) == successor["graph"]["currentSourceBytes"],
            "Following source counts differ")

    receiving = successor["receiving"]
    target = absolute(args.output)
    no_symlinks(target)
    for name in ("originalPerformanceSourceRoot", "originalFoundationSourceRoot", "nativeRun", "performanceRun", "financialRun"):
        if receiving.get(name):
            require(disjoint(target, absolute(receiving[name])), "Source destination overlaps saved " + name)
    performance_run = absolute(receiving["performanceRun"])
    performance = read_record(performance_run / "flow-result.json")
    require(performance is not None
            and performance.get("schema") == "stellar-forge.merchant-performance-customer-result.v1"
            and performance.get("state") == "COMPLETE"
            and performance.get("operationDirectory") == str(performance_run),
            "Finish the existing Performance operation using its recorded source tree before this continuation")
    operation = read_record(absolute(receiving["financialRun"]) / "operation.json")
    if operation is not None:
        require(operation.get("sourceRoot") == str(target),
                "The existing financial operation must retain its recorded sourceRoot: " + str(operation.get("sourceRoot")))

    # Check every existing destination before publishing any source file.
    for path, (_, data) in following.items():
        destination = target / relative(path)
        no_symlinks(destination)
        if destination.exists():
            require(stat.S_ISREG(destination.stat().st_mode), "Expected a regular source file: " + str(destination))
            existing = destination.read_bytes()
            previous = base.get(path)
            require(existing == data or (previous is not None and existing == previous[1]),
                    "Existing source has another identity: " + str(destination))
    durable_directory(target)
    written = 0
    for path, (_, data) in following.items():
        previous = base.get(path)
        written += atomic_source(target / relative(path), data, previous[1] if previous else None)
    print(json.dumps({
        "schema": "stellar-forge.merchant-performance-financial-source-receiving.v1",
        "state": "SOURCE_READY", "sourceRoot": str(target), "files": len(following),
        "sourceBytes": sum(len(data) for _, data in following.values()), "writtenFiles": written,
        "baseSourceGitBlob": BASE_GIT, "successorGitBlob": git_blob(successor_bytes),
        "successorSha256": hashlib.sha256(successor_bytes).hexdigest(),
        "performanceRun": str(performance_run), "performanceState": performance["state"],
        "financialOperationRetained": operation is not None
    }, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
